vi: Chương trình + tài liệu đi kèm (requirements, design models, user manuals). Generic: bán cho nhiều khách. Custom: một khách, theo spec.
en: Programs + associated documentation. Generic: sold to many customers. Custom: one customer, to their spec.

vi: Maintainability (evolve) · Dependability/Reliability (trustworthy) · Efficiency (không lãng phí tài nguyên) · Acceptability (understandable, usable, compatible).
en: Maintainability · Dependability/Reliability · Efficiency · Acceptability.

vi: ~60% development / 40% testing. Hệ thống sống lâu: maintenance gấp nhiều lần development. Custom: evolution > development.
en: ~60% development / 40% testing. Long-lived systems: maintenance several times development.

vi: 35% successful · 46% challenged · 19% failed.
en: 35% successful · 46% challenged · 19% failed.

f: SE vs CS vs System Engineering
vi: CS: lý thuyết, nền tảng. SE: thực tiễn phát triển và bàn giao phần mềm. System Eng.: HW + SW + process, bao trùm SE.
en: CS: theory. SE: practicalities of delivering software. System eng.: hardware + software + process.

vi: Cost effective (within budget) · On time · High quality · Satisfying customer's needs.
en: Cost effective · On time · High quality · Satisfying customer's needs.

vi: Specification (làm gì + ràng buộc) · Development · Validation (đúng ý khách?) · Evolution.
en: Specification · Development · Validation · Evolution.

vi: Workflow: trình tự · Data-flow: luồng thông tin · Role/action: ai làm gì.
en: Workflow · Data-flow · Role/action (who does what).

vi: CI: tích hợp code tự động, thường xuyên. CD: tự động build, test, sẵn sàng release. DevOps: văn hoá + practices + tools rút ngắn SDLC.
en: CI: frequent automatic integration. CD: auto build/test, release-ready. DevOps: culture + practices + tools to shorten the SDLC.

vi: Public · Client & Employer · Product · Judgment · Management · Profession · Colleagues · Self (lifelong learning).
en: Public · Client & Employer · Product · Judgment · Management · Profession · Colleagues · Self.

vi: Confidentiality · Competence · Intellectual property rights · Computer misuse. Đạo đức hơn cả tuân thủ pháp luật.
en: Confidentiality · Competence · IP rights · Computer misuse. Ethics is more than upholding the law.

vi: Plan-driven: plan trước, đo theo plan, document-based, heavy. Agile: plan incremental, đổi theo requirement, tacit knowledge, light.
en: Plan-driven: planned, measured against plan, document-based, heavy. Agile: incremental planning, tacit knowledge, light.

vi: Plan-driven: Waterfall, Incremental, Spiral, RUP. Agile: XP, Scrum, Kanban.
en: Plan-driven: Waterfall, Incremental, Spiral, RUP. Agile: XP, Scrum, Kanban.

vi: 1 Initial (reactive) → 2 Managed (mức project) → 3 Defined (chuẩn toàn tổ chức) → 4 Quantitatively Managed (data-driven) → 5 Optimizing. V3.0 (2023), ISACA.
en: Initial → Managed (project) → Defined (organization) → Quantitatively Managed → Optimizing. V3.0 (2023), ISACA.

vi: Requirements definition → Analysis & Design → Implementation & Unit Testing → Integration & System Testing → Operation & Maintenance. Code khi req đã baseline; quay lại được.
en: Requirements → Analysis & Design → Implementation & Unit Test → Integration & System Test → Operation & Maintenance.

vi: ✓ chức năng có sớm, increment đầu như prototype, ưu tiên cao được test nhiều, giảm rủi ro. ✗ process không visible, cấu trúc xuống cấp.
en: + early functionality, lower risk. − process not visible, structure degrades.

vi: Plan → Risk Analysis (prototyping) → Engineering → Evaluate. Mỗi vòng = 1 phase. ✓ quản lý rủi ro, dự án lớn. ✗ phức tạp, đắt.
en: Plan → Risk Analysis → Engineering → Evaluate; each loop = a phase. + risk focus. − complex, expensive.

vi: Inception (business case) → Elaboration (domain + kiến trúc) → Construction (design, code, test) → Transition (deploy). Mỗi iteration = 1 chu kỳ waterfall.
en: Inception → Elaboration → Construction → Transition. Each iteration is a waterfall cycle.

vi: Individuals & interactions > processes & tools · Working software > documentation · Customer collaboration > contract negotiation · Responding to change > following a plan.
en: Individuals & interactions · Working software · Customer collaboration · Responding to change.

vi: Planning Game · Small Releases · Metaphor · Simple Design · Acceptance Testing · Refactoring · Pair Programming · Collective Ownership · Continuous Integration · 40-hour Week · On-site Customer · Coding Standards.
en: Planning Game, Small Releases, Metaphor, Simple Design, Acceptance Testing, Refactoring, Pair Programming, Collective Ownership, CI, 40-hour Week, On-site Customer, Coding Standards.

vi: Product Backlog ↔ Product Goal · Sprint Backlog ↔ Sprint Goal · Increment ↔ Definition of Done.
en: Product Backlog ↔ Product Goal · Sprint Backlog ↔ Sprint Goal · Increment ↔ Definition of Done.

vi: ≤ 10 người, 3 trách nhiệm: PO (value, Product Goal, order backlog) · SM (coach, gỡ impediments) · Developers (Sprint Backlog, Increment, DoD). KHÔNG có manager/team lead.
en: ≤ 10 people; PO, Scrum Master, Developers. No manager or team lead.

vi: Sprint (≤ 1 tháng, chứa mọi event) · Sprint Planning · Daily Scrum 15' · Sprint Review (với stakeholders) · Retrospective (cách team làm). Release planning và burndown KHÔNG bắt buộc.
en: Sprint ≤ 1 month · Planning · Daily 15' · Review · Retrospective. Release planning and burndown are not required.

vi: Taiichi Ohno (Toyota) → David J. Anderson (~2004). Practices: visualize flow, limit WIP, cumulative flow diagram. Không có iteration.
en: Ohno (Toyota) → Anderson (~2004). Visualize, limit WIP, CFD. No iterations.

vi: Scope · Time · Budget. Production → product · Investment → benefit · Research → knowledge.
en: Scope · Time · Budget. Production → product; Investment → benefit; Research → knowledge.

f: PM vs Engineering Manager vs Team Lead
vi: PM: scope, schedule, cost, risk, stakeholders. EM: chất lượng kỹ thuật, năng lực team, kiến trúc. TL: điều phối kỹ thuật hằng ngày, giao task.
en: PM: scope/schedule/cost/risk. EM: technical quality, team capability. TL: daily technical coordination.

vi: Initiation (feasibility, proposal) → Planning (scope, WBS, estimate, schedule) → Executing (weekly plan, tasks) → Tracking & Control (progress report, issue log, change request).
en: Initiation → Planning → Executing → Tracking & Control.

vi: Chia scope thành work item nhỏ: phase → deliverable → task. Mỗi item phải assign, estimate, track được.
en: Breaks scope into items that can be assigned, estimated and tracked.

vi: $\text{Effort} = a \times \text{KLOC}^{b}$ · $\text{Duration} = c \times \text{Effort}^{d}$ · $\text{Cost} = \text{Effort} \times$ giá/man-month. LOC phụ thuộc ngôn ngữ; FP độc lập ngôn ngữ.
en: $\text{Effort} = a \times \text{KLOC}^{b}$ · $\text{Duration} = c \times \text{Effort}^{d}$ · $\text{Cost} = \text{Effort} \times \text{rate}$. FP is language-independent.

vi: 24 person-hours, 1 SV × 3h/ngày = 8 ngày; 2 SV ≈ 4 ngày, nhưng thêm người không giảm thời gian tuyến tính.
en: 24 person-hours at 3 h/day = 8 days; more people does not scale linearly.

vi: Story points = effort + complexity + uncertainty (Planning Poker, Fibonacci). $\text{Số sprint} \approx \dfrac{\text{points còn lại}}{\text{velocity}}$ (120/20 = 6). Không so velocity giữa team.
en: $\text{Sprints} \approx \dfrac{\text{remaining points}}{\text{velocity}}$ (120/20 = 6). Don't compare teams by velocity.

vi: Milestone: điểm kết thúc một giai đoạn. Deliverable: kết quả giao cho khách/user (Build, alpha, beta, GA).
en: Milestone: end-point of a period. Deliverable: result delivered to customers.

vi: Chuỗi task phụ thuộc DÀI NHẤT = thời gian tối thiểu. $\text{Slack} = \text{LS} - \text{ES}$; task găng slack = 0. Ví dụ slide: 14 ngày, cả 2 đường đều găng.
en: LONGEST chain = minimum duration; critical tasks have zero slack. Slide example: 14 days.

vi: Identify → Analyze → Plan → Monitor. $\text{RE} = \text{Probability} \times \text{Loss}$, thang 10/25/50/75/90. Likely × Catastrophic = 75 × 90 = 6,750.
en: Identify → Analyze → Plan → Monitor. $\text{RE} = P \times L$; Likely × Catastrophic = 6,750.

vi: Technology · People · Organizational · Requirements · Estimation.
en: Technology · People · Organizational · Requirements · Estimation.

vi: Avoidance · Minimization · Contingency plans (dùng khi rủi ro xảy ra) · Risk transfer · Buying information.
en: Avoidance · Minimization · Contingency · Transfer · Buying information.

vi: Services hệ thống cung cấp + constraints. Chức năng kép: cơ sở cho bid/contract (high level) và cho dev team (detailed).
en: Services + constraints. Basis for a bid/contract (high level) and for developers (detailed).

vi: Interactor: khách hàng + account database. Indirect: quản lý, nhân viên bảo mật. Domain: chuẩn giao tiếp liên ngân hàng.
en: Interactor: customers + account database. Indirect: management, security. Domain: inter-bank standards.

vi: User: ngôn ngữ tự nhiên, góc nhìn user, high-level. System: tài liệu có cấu trúc, chi tiết, định nghĩa cái cần implement.
en: User: natural language, high-level. System: structured, detailed, what to implement.

vi: F: hệ thống phản ứng thế nào. NF: ràng buộc (Product / Organizational / External). Domain: từ lĩnh vực ứng dụng (Z39.50, bản quyền).
en: F: behavior. NF: constraints (Product / Organizational / External). Domain: from the application domain.

vi: Có thước đo kiểm tra khách quan. Ví dụ: dùng được mọi chức năng sau 2 giờ đào tạo; ≤ 2 lỗi/ngày.
en: Uses an objective measure, e.g. two hours of training, ≤ 2 errors/day.

vi: Must: thiếu là release fail · Should: quan trọng, có cách lách · Could: có thì tốt · Won't (this time): thoả thuận bỏ khỏi release này.
en: Must · Should (workaround exists) · Could · Won't (this time).

vi: Interview: direct/indirect, open/closed; tốn thời gian khách, khó kiểm soát. Observe: thấy quy trình thật; tốn thời gian dev, có thể làm phiền khách.
en: Interview costs client time. Observation costs team time and may interfere with the client's business.

vi: SRS nêu WHAT, không HOW. IEEE 830 (1998) → ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018.
en: SRS states WHAT not HOW. IEEE 830 → ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018.

vi: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable. Acceptance criteria dạng Given/When/Then → acceptance test cases.
en: INVEST; acceptance criteria as Given/When/Then become acceptance tests.

vi: Validity · Verifiability · Consistency · Completeness · Realism.
en: Validity · Verifiability · Consistency · Completeness · Realism.

vi: Reviews (phổ biến nhất) · Prototyping · Test-case generation.
en: Reviews (most common) · Prototyping · Test-case generation.

vi: Change request → analysis & costing → implementation. Traceability matrix: req ↔ use case ↔ design ↔ test → impact analysis, test coverage.
en: Request → analysis & costing → implementation. Traceability for impact analysis and coverage.

vi: Booch, Rumbaugh, Jacobson (Rational). OMG chuẩn hoá năm 1997.
en: Booch, Rumbaugh, Jacobson; adopted by OMG in 1997.

vi: Structural: class, package, object, component, deployment. Behavioral: use case, sequence, communication, state machine, activity.
en: Structural: class, package, object, component, deployment. Behavioral: use case, sequence, communication, state, activity.

vi: Một role tương tác với hệ thống (người, process, thứ khác). 1 người nhiều role; nhiều người cùng role = 1 actor; actor có generalization.
en: A role; one user can play many roles; same role = one actor; actors can generalize.

vi: Use case: chuỗi hành động tạo giá trị cho actor; WHAT không HOW; 1 basic flow + alternative/exceptional flows. Scenario = 1 instance của use case.
en: Use case: WHAT not HOW; basic + alternative flows. Scenario = an instance.

vi: Include: base BIẾT, included không đứng một mình (Checkout → Payment). Extend: base KHÔNG biết, extending đứng một mình được; mũi tên từ extending → base (Verify shipping address → Checkout).
en: Include: base aware, included can't stand alone. Extend: base unaware, extending may stand alone; arrow extending → base.

vi: UI: look & feel của màn hình. UX: toàn bộ trải nghiệm. Trí nhớ ngắn hạn ~4 ± 1 (Miller 7 ± 2).
en: UI: look & feel. UX: overall experience. Short-term memory ~4 ± 1 (Miller 7 ± 2).

vi: User familiarity · Consistency · Minimal surprise · Recoverability · User guidance · User diversity.
en: Familiarity · Consistency · Minimal surprise · Recoverability · Guidance · Diversity.

vi: Perceivable (alt text, tương phản ≥ 4.5:1) · Operable (bàn phím) · Understandable (nhãn rõ) · Robust (semantic HTML). Không dùng mỗi màu sắc.
en: Perceivable (≥ 4.5:1) · Operable (keyboard) · Understandable · Robust. Never color alone.

vi: Direct manipulation · Menu selection · Form fill-in (nhập liệu) · Command language (học cú pháp) · Natural language.
en: Direct manipulation · Menu · Form fill-in · Command language · Natural language.

vi: User analysis (task analysis, interview, ethnography) → System prototyping (paper → automated) → Interface evaluation (learnability, speed, robustness, recoverability, adaptability).
en: User analysis → Prototyping (paper → automated) → Evaluation.

vi: Thông báo lỗi: polite, concise, consistent, constructive. Data validation: không tin người dùng; natural/business constraints; early/late checking.
en: Polite, concise, consistent, constructive. Don't trust users; early/late checking.
